cues: For a microscope, what matters is the smallest separation x between two points on the slide: one point two two lambda over two mu sine theta.
Theta is the half angle of the cone of light entering the objective, and mu sine theta is the numerical aperture.
So use shorter wavelengths, even electrons, or put a drop of cedar oil, index one point five, under the objective: oil immersion.
